# kiln v0.9.1

v0.9.1 fixes kiln's startup time on meld-fused modules. kiln 0.9.0 copied a memory provider's whole 8 MiB buffer for each function and each instruction it parsed, so loading took seconds on macOS and timed out on x86_64 Linux runners (kiln#748). The examples below were run with the same fused module and arguments on both versions:

| fused module | kiln 0.9.0 | kiln 0.9.1 (main at release) |
|---|---|---|
| sieve 0.4.3 `--version`, 4.16 MB, macOS arm64 | 6.75–7.46 s | 0.05 s |
| sieve 0.4.6 `--version`, 4.37 MB, macOS arm64 | 8.07 s | 0.12 s |
| jig `pins .`, 2.03 MB, macOS arm64 | 5 s | under 1 s |
| sieve planted case, x86_64 Linux CI (sieve run 46014739196) | killed at 300 s and 900 s | 1 s |

Output is identical to native in every case. sieve's 55-case corpus is byte-identical to native sieve on main. Interpreter execution speed is unchanged: the corpus takes 6 min 56 s under kiln against about 13 s under wasmtime.

This is a patch release cut from main. It claims no v0.10.0 requirement as verified; SR-129's 1.0 s target is checked by a CI job still in review (#749).

## Changes
- **Startup:** `HeapProvider` allocates on write and no longer copies its buffer on clone, so parsing a function body costs time in proportion to the body, not to the provider's capacity (#737, SR-129, AD-STARTUP-001).
- **Preopens:** `--dir HOST::GUEST` preopens HOST under the guest name GUEST, as wasmtime does (SR-126, #727).
- **Verification:** a per-PR Kani job checks the proof ledger, runs the 4 verifying harnesses and a mutation control, and is a required check; the always-red scheduled Kani matrix and an audit job that could not fail are retired (SR-121, #729, #730, #731). `cargo-kiln kani-verify` runs `cargo kani` and fails a package with no verified harness (#726).
- **Dependencies:** regex 1.13.2 (#735), rivet-yaml v0.42.2 (#738), actions/dependency-review-action (#734); Dependabot grouped monthly (#732).
- **Docs:** the Pages deploy fails unless the live site serves this build (#742); README lists WASI 0.2 filesystem, args, env and exit as working (#739).

Verify the checksums with the exact identity:

```
cosign verify-blob --bundle SHA256SUMS.txt.cosign.bundle \
  --certificate-identity 'https://github.com/pulseengine/kiln/.github/workflows/release.yml@refs/tags/v0.9.1' \
  --certificate-oidc-issuer https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com \
  SHA256SUMS.txt
```

## Known limitations
- Fused modules above 8 MiB, or with a function of more than 256 local groups, are refused (#745, #747).
- kiln still refuses an unfused component with `E03ED No core instance exports _start`, which does not name `meld fuse` as the required step (#480).
- Interpreter execution is about 30 times slower than wasmtime on sieve's corpus.
- kiln has no witness MC/DC truth tables and no sigil attestation; release assets are covered by the cosign-signed `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

## Falsification statement
This release is wrong if:
- `kiln --wasi --import-map sieve.map.json sieve.fused.wasm --version` on sieve v0.4.6 fused by meld v0.70.0 takes more than 2.0 s (median of 5) on an x86_64 Linux GitHub-hosted runner;
- jig's or sieve's kiln differential job, pinned to this release, reports a hang or any output that differs from native;
- `kiln --version` prints anything other than `kiln 0.9.1`;
- `cosign verify-blob` with the identity above does not print `Verified OK` for this release's `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
